posts.headline: Founder / CTO @ OpenRelay
posts.body:
We're hiring an LLM inference optimization engineer at OpenRelay. San Francisco, in person.
We run production inference across multiple kinds of silicon and route workloads based on real-time latency and cost. This role owns performance end to end: routing, scheduling, batching, memory, down to the kernels. Large deployments, high qps traffic.
If you've spent time squeezing latency out of inference stacks, or you know someone who has, send them my way. DMs open.

We're hiring on their behalf for a hands-on, contract-to-hire role building and deploying machine learning models that power credit risk and decisioning workflows. Not a supporting player. This is core to how the business makes decisions.

- 5+ years in AI/ML engineering, with hands-on experience in Financial Services or FinTech

On-site, Southern California.
